title: orch pending input v1 (one line of .orch/run/pending/<ticket id>.jsonl)
description: Input for a ticket whose agent is busy, appended under the ticket lock. Live runs get it pasted when idle; oneshot runs get one more (resume) turn with what is left. Delivery is at-least-once, deduped by line id in a record in the guarded orch home (not by delivered_at, which is display only), and survives a crash. Gitignored.

id.description: Random, unique per line; the dedupe key.

by.description: Free actor name, as in run.by.

via.description: Optional free word: the surface it came from.

text.description: What the agent is told, plain text.

delivered_at.description: Set once the agent got it. Not covered by mac and not authority: delivery is deduped by line id in a record in the guarded orch home (human-proof.md), so removing delivered_at never re-delivers.

mac.description: Optional. base64url HMAC-SHA256 with this workspace's human key (guarded orch home) over the canonical JSON of {workspace, ticket, line without mac and delivered_at}, written by the core when it accepted a person's input with a proof (page) or from its own relay client (phone). Verified on every read; without a valid mac the line is an agent's. delivered_at is not covered.

human.description: Informational only, never trusted: a self-written human: true (or a human: by, or via phone) does not make a line a person's. Only a valid mac does (human-proof.md, read-back rule).
